title: Coefficient tensor squares pass to signed total complexes
statement: Let C,D,E be additive monoidal categories with small colimits, G,F1,F2:C→D and Gprime,F1prime,F2prime:C→E additive functors, and H:D→E an additive oplax monoidal functor. Assume G,Gprime,H preserve small colimits. Given tensor coefficient comparisons tau and tauprime of the ordinary tensor bifunctors, and natural transformations a0:Gprime→G H, a1:F1prime→F1 H, a2:F2prime→F2 H, assume the ordinary coefficient tensor square commutes on every pair M,N. Then the square of their signed total comparisons and degreewise transformations commutes on every pair of unbounded cochain complexes P,Q.

source.place: Tag 0F1E; ordinary coefficient normalization and signed totalization in step 11 of lem-pur-supported-product-localization.

proof.text: In every total degree use coproduct extensionality for the image under Gprime of the bidegree summands. Naturality of a0 moves it past the summand inclusion.

The bidegree normalization of each total comparison reduces the two sides to the assumed ordinary square. The inclusions commute with the tensor of the two degreewise maps. Chain-map extensionality completes the equality, with signed differentials already built into totalization.

theorem supportedTensorComplex_square
    {C D E : Type*} [Category.{w} C] [Category.{w} D] [Category.{w} E]
    [Preadditive C] [Preadditive D] [Preadditive E]
    [MonoidalCategory C] [MonoidalCategory D] [MonoidalCategory E]
    [MonoidalPreadditive C] [MonoidalPreadditive D] [MonoidalPreadditive E]
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} C] [HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} D]
    [HasColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} E]
    (G F₁ F₂ : C ⥤ D) (G' F₁' F₂' : C ⥤ E) (H : D ⥤ E)
    [G.Additive] [F₁.Additive] [F₂.Additive]
    [G'.Additive] [F₁'.Additive] [F₂'.Additive] [H.Additive] [H.OplaxMonoidal]
    [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} G] [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} G']
    [PreservesColimitsOfSize.{0, 0} H]
    (τ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj G).obj (curriedTensor C) ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ D).obj F₁).obj F₂).obj (curriedTensor D))
    (τ' : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj G').obj (curriedTensor C) ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ E).obj F₁').obj F₂').obj (curriedTensor E))
    (a₀ : G' ⟶ G ⋙ H) (a₁ : F₁' ⟶ F₁ ⋙ H) (a₂ : F₂' ⟶ F₂ ⋙ H)
    (ha : ∀ M N, a₀.app (M ⊗ N) ≫ H.map ((τ.app M).app N) ≫
      Functor.OplaxMonoidal.δ H (F₁.obj M) (F₂.obj N) =
      (τ'.app M).app N ≫ (a₁.app M ⊗ₘ a₂.app N))
    (P Q : CochainComplex C ℤ) :
    supportedTensorComplexSquareCondition G F₁ F₂ G' F₁' F₂' H τ τ' a₀ a₁ a₂ P Q
